_comment: Every gate in TRD Section 9 is enumerated here, mapped by its `trd` number rather than by position - the manifest renumbers, so a positional comparison silently misleads. A `trd` of null marks a gate this project added beyond the TRD. check-ci-gates.mjs fails if any TRD gate number is unclaimed, if a wired gate's exact command is absent from ci.yml, if a wired gate runs without blocking (if:, continue-on-error, || true), or if a pending gate names no open story.

gates.gate: Typecheck; no `any` in a public signature
Lint; token-tier and literal rules in component CSS
Unit + interaction tests pass
Statement coverage >= 90%; branch coverage >= 85%
axe: zero serious or critical violations
Keyboard interaction suite, incl. focus-identity assertions
Visual regression: no unreviewed diffs
Token contrast, both themes, row count matched
Computed geometry: heights, target size, type floors (rendered)
Mutation score >= 70% on changed files
API report diff clean
publint, attw, no exports wildcard
gates.run: pnpm check:publint && pnpm check:attw && pnpm check

gates.gate: Size budgets
Consumer verification: Vite + Next.js builds, no hydration warnings
Server/client boundary: every exported component is classified
Tarball install-safety: no workspace/link protocol, every exports target shipped
Public token reference: docs or examples reference a non-tier-2 token
Changeset present on any packages/ change
pnpm audit: no high or critical CVE in a runtime dependency
Scoped theming and density reach tier 3
Density token contract: padding, target, adjacent-target

plus.gate: A changeset is present on any packages/ change
pnpm audit clean of high/critical CVEs
